_comment: Shared contract between api/app/blog/markdown.py and web/app/blog/_lib/markdown.ts. Both sides parse headings.md and must produce exactly these ids: the contents box on the web is built from one side and the anchors from the other, so a single character of drift breaks every in-page link. See markdown.py's module docstring for the algorithm.
